item.title: Florida State University Launches Quantum Science and Technology Graduate Certificate
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Florida State University is launching Florida’s first formal graduate-level credential in quantum information science and engineering, opening a new pathway for students and professionals to enter one of the world’s fastest-growing technology fields. The Graduate Certificate in Quantum Science & Technology is now accepting applications for Spring 2027 enrollment. Administered by the FSU Quantum […]
